tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras mdung dmar can gyi rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor bzhugs so//
khro lo dang gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab gter ma/

oṃ swasti pra dzñā bh+yaḥ khro phu lo tsā ba chen po byams pa'i dpal dang*/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyi gter byon rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras mdung dmar can gyi skor la/ gnod sbyin dbyug to can gyi rgyud le'u bdun pa slob dpon pad+ma'i rgya dpe las gnyags dang bai ro sogs kyis bsgyur ba dang*/ de'i le'u tha ma tshe sgrub kyi gsal byed bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa gnyis khro phu lo tsā bas bya rgod gshong nas spyan drangs pa/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyi gter byon dang yig rnying skor la/ sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ rjes su gnang ba'i yig chung*/ tshe sgrub kyi man ngag /rnam sras dmar po srog len gyi las sbyor zhal gdams/ sgab 'dre shes pa dkar po bse byang la brten nas mnan thabs/ rgyal po gzhan la mi chags pa'i thabs/ ma 'chun na 'jun pa'i man ngag /ha ya grī bas dbang du bsdu ba/ gud na gso ba/ ya ma srog las kyi yig sna/ gnad la dbab pa'i tho/ srog rtsa yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ bsgrub bya'i rtsa gsum 'dus pa zhes yod pa'i gnad yig gsang ba/ gsang yum bzhi'i zhal gdams/ rnam sras dmar po srog len gyi yig sna/ myur mgyogs glog gi phreng ba/ rnam sras dmar po'i srog sgrub ces rten gtor ri rab ma bca' ba'i zhal gdams sgrub thabs dngos grub blang ba dang bcas pa/ bla rdo bca' thabs/ sngags byang bcas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/

rgyal chen mdung dmar can gyi las tshogs 'khor lo'i bri yig la/ gri snying 'khor lo/ snang ba dbang sdud kyi tsakra mu khyud drug pa/ gtor ma rin chen spungs pa'i 'khor lo/ bla rdo 'cha' ba'i 'khor lo/ gwa'u bca' ba'i 'khor lo/ bse rag 'gong po mnan 'khor/ bse rag gi ltas dang kha chings rigs gnyis/ de'i lhan thabs/ srog 'khor dang dbang sdud 'khor lo 'bri tshul bsdus pa/ snang ba dbang sdud kyi tsakra mu khyud lnga pa'i bri yig bcas legs par bzhugs so// maṅga laṃ/// / ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ dha naḥku be rā dza tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po dbyug to can zhes bya ba'i rgyud/

ya mān+ta ka la/

dngos su phul/ de nas dpal chen po de nyid kyis rang rang gi srog gi snying po rnams nus mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar gnyer gtad do/ khyad par du'ang ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po dbyug pa can zhes bya ba 'khor

ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs na// rin chen dam pa'i pho brang na// gnod sbyin dbang po lus ngan po// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing*// bse rmog bse khrab bse l+h+wam gsol// 'jigs bral lag ldan dgra la 'chib// spyan zlum mche ba rnam par gtsigs// le brgan dar gyi cod pan 'phur// phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan dngos grub stsol// dam nyams snying 'byin bse mdung bsnams// phyag g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa dang*// dbang sdud lcags kyu 'bar ba 'dzin// 'khor bcas thugs dam dus la babs// phrin las ma lus sgrub byed pa'i// sras mchog bzhi dang gshed ma bzhi// sras kyi thu bo dzaṃ bha la// bdud kyi rgyal por sku sprul nas// sku la bse khrab zhol can gsol// phyag na bse yi mdung dmar thogs// dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar po drongs// sde brgyad gtso bo rā hu la// 'jig rten 'jigs mdzad mche ba can// chu srin rgyal mtshan mda' gzhu 'dzin// bstan pa'i dgra bo myur du sgrol// bdud 'dul gnod sbyin ku be ra// mdog nag ber chen sprin ltar gtibs// lag na bse mdung dmar po 'dzin// bstan pa'i dgra bo myur du sgrol// dus mtshan nag po srog gi gshed/ khro gtum shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs// be con 'bar ba phyag na bsnams// dgra bgegs khug drongs snying la rol// dregs pa dred sna ba dan 'phyar// bum sna dregs pa mdung dmar thogs// sna 'phyang dregs pa rgyal mtshan 'dzin// sna chen dregs pa dar mdung bsnams// ya ma rā dza srog gi gshed// myos byed 'bar ba 'jigs pa'i sku// me ru tse ni khro zhing rngams// ral pa tshar dgu dgra snying 'byin// sku mdog dmar nag thun khrag dang*// mtshon cha 'bar ba phyag na bsnams// gshed ma chen po khyed bzhi dang*// las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas kyis// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo dang*// 'khor la gnod pa'i 'byung po dang*// bla ma'i sku dgra sems can 'tshe// bstan pa bshig dang dkon mchog smad// mdor na log par zhugs pa rnams// zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdoms/

khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus// gcod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis// chod cig non cig khug par gyis// thul cig choms shig rnam par shigs// rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis// bstan pa srung ba'i las 'di sgrubs// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par gyis// gzhan yang bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad dang*// byur dang skal pa ngan pa sogs// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzod// gsang ba'i yum chen mched bzhi dang*// lha dang lha min klu dbang dang*// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs// thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad// nor bdag klu chen brgyad rnams kyis// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa'i// gnod sbyin ded dpon 'khor bcas kyis// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// 1$0000250ces phrin las bskul zhing gtor ma byang phyogs su gtong ba'am dgra phyogs su gtang ba skabs dang sbyar/ mthar ye shes pa gshegs/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya/ rten yod na slar bstim/ 1$0000300de ltar rgyun du bsten pa las// gling bzhi dag kyang g.yo 'gul byed// 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyi// mi nor zas gsum 'du ba dang*// mi rnams kun gyis bkur sti byed// lhag par bud med gus par 'gyur// gzhan yang phrin las dpag med 'grub// ces sogs phan yon dpag tu med pas bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod la brtson par bya'o/// /gsum pa las sbyor gyi rim pa ni/

gsang zhing gzhan du shes par bya ba yin pas 'dir ma bris so// 'di bris dge bas 'gro ba kun// dbul phongs bdud las rnam rgyal nas// nam mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor zhing*// ngal bsos dge ba 'grub par shog // 1$0000270'bad de bgyis pa'i dge ba gang*// bdag sogs 'gro ba dpag med rnams// zad med longs spyod tshe 'phel nas// mthar thug zad med mdzod la spyod par shog// / 1$0000300༄༅// rgyal po chen po'i rjes su gnang ba'i gdams ngag bzhugs so// bai shra ma ṇā rā dza na mo/ rgyal po chen po'i rjes su gnang ba'i gdams ngag 'di la/ mu khyud shad gang 'dzom mda' gang tshad gcig byas la/ gri lcags las byas pa'i mdung*/ mdung so gri khrag gis ngar blud la gzug /ske la dar dmar po la srog sngags bris la bcug /gtor ma zas sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa gcig bsham/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du bzhag /mthar mchod pa dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs bsham/ slob mas khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis gsol ba gdab/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ dung phor dri bzang gis bkang ba gcig bsham/ de nas bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bsgom/ mdun du ma hā rā dza bsgom/ slob ma rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bsgom du bcug la/ slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gyis// lag tu rdo rje thogs nas ni// ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur bya// spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas ni// 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ste// sangs rgyas thams cad kun gyi gtso// dregs pa spyi yi rgyal po mchog

/gsang ba'i bdag nyid chen po 'di/ khyod la bdag gis de ring bskur// oṃ ma hā kā la a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ de ni dregs pa spyi gnon gyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas gtor ma snying gar gtad la/ rgyal po chen po nyid 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed la bstim/ lus ngag yid gsum la 'khor nas lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'khor bar bsam/ oṃ bai rā dza ma ma si ti dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'di ni rgyal po chen po ste/ khams gsum dbang sdud dbang gi bdag /dngos grub gnyan po chen po ni/ khyed la deng 'dir bskur thob shog /kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ sarba sid+dhi tsit+ta hūm̐/ zhes gtor ma snying gar gtad/ mdung dar lag tu bzhag la/ 'di ni dbang gi mdung dar te// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed// 'gro ba thams cad dbang du sdud// dbang gi dbang bskur khyed la gtad// oṃ bai rā dza ma ma dung dung phaṭa/ de nas dri'i dung chos lce thog tu bzhag la/ bdud rtsi ro mchog dam pa 'dis// zas nor longs spyod char ltar 'beb// 'jig rten zas bcud rnams kyis ni// bdud rtsi byas te khyod la bskur// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi lcer bzhag la bza' ru bcug /rjes gtor ma dngos grub tu slob dpon gyis rol/ bsngo ba bkra shis bcas/ mdung dar slob bu'i rten du bcang*/

ma trag bzhi'i srog sngags btags pa dang*/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdus gzhan dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ bla rdo gta' ru bzung nas gzungs thag dang sbrel te las la sbyar ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi sham bu btags pas lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor char ltar dbang du bsdu ba'i man ngag la/ dang po gzhung bsnyen tshar nas zas dang gang dbang du bsdu 'dod pa la/ bdag gis rnam thos sras gzhung ltar bsgoms la/ rang gi tsit+ta rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i gur/ de'i nang du nyi ma'i dal dmar ser dmar kyi le ba gcig gi steng du rnam thos sras seng ge la 'chib pa tshon gang ba gcig bsgom/ de'i snying ga'i dbus su bai dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba gcig bsgom/ rgyab tu zangs kyi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs bzhi pa/ ma trag re re bsam la de yongs su gyur pa las mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na 'gugs byed kyi lcags kyu bsnams pa/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ de re re'i steng du nyi ma'i dal dmar ser ltem me ba sran 'bru glebs pa tsam re re'i steng du ma trag sbrel ma re re la sngags kyis dmar sgor re bskor bar bsam mo// de nas rmi lam gzhung nas bshad pa byung tshar nas ma mkha' 'gro'i sngags btags/ de nas dngos grub sngags btags/ de yang 'od zer 'phro ba'i dus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od dmar lam lam gsal ba de'i nang du 'od zer skar mda' lta bus gang dmigs pa'i snying dkyil du yi ge nṛ ljang gu yod pa'i nṛ mig tu bai dmar po gcig gsal ba las/

rnam thos sras nas 'bru tsam gcig bskyed pa'i zhabs su zangs kyi dkyil 'khor sen mo tsam pa'i steng du mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bskyed la/ zangs kyi dkyil 'khor dmar sgor ro ro 'khor bas kho'i lus dmar si li li tsha 'ub 'ub ded nas/ mthu dang nus pa bkrag dang gzi mdangs rnams 'od kyi thig le dmar po gcig po 'od zer lcags kyus blangs nas rang gi snying ga'i bai dmar la bstim/ ma ma trag sid+dhi sa ma ya/ ma ma trag bā su dung dung*/ ma ma trag kha dhe yang yang*/ ma ma trag tsit+ta bā su dhā ri hrīṃ dzaḥhūm̐/ bai rā dza ma ma sid+dhi bā su rat+na hūm̐ dzaḥhrīṃ hrīṃ/ zhes bsnyen sngags la rim bzhin btags la/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dbang du bsdu 'o// thun 'jog tsa na kho'i lus mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la thim/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rnam sras la thim/ de gzi brjid dang ldan pa tshur byon pas rang gi snying gar thim/ ༈ nyams pa bsgral na wa thod kyi nang du liṅga mtshan nyid dpe'u chung ltar bris la/ snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi bris/ dbus su nṛ dkyil du bai bris la rtsibs bzhi la ya ma rā dza'i srog sngags dgod/ tha mar sngags kyis lan gsum bskor/ bai ya ma rā dza bhi nu mā ra ri tsi gtor
che ge mo

mā ra ya rbad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rā dza sid+dhi bai sa ma ya/ a ho bh+rūm̐ rbad/ sha ma ru ti rbad/ ces lan gsum bskor/ thun thag snying gar drang*/ wa thod nang du bcug /zangs khab/ rdo pha wang long bu snying gar bzhag pa'i phyi la za 'og skud pa rnams sbrel la/ gsang sngags rang rnam thos sras ya ma dmar po gshin rje'i cha lugs can/ sku la gsod byed kyi shan pa 'phro ba/ shar na ya ma rā dza/ lho na smyo byed 'bar ba/ nub na ār+ya me ru tse/ byang na ral pa tshar dgu/ sku mdog dmar nag phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs dang khrag thun bsnams pa bskyed/ 'od zer 'phros pas dmigs bya bkug la rū pa la bstim/ lha dbye ba la wa thod gshin rje'i btson khang
che ge mo

gsal bar bkug la/ las kyi gshin rje rnams kyis sha zos khrag 'thung med par btang bar bsam la/ sems can bsad par dmigs na/ mdun na rā hu la dmar po bai dmar po/ sngags 'di btags la sbyin sreg bya'o// nyi zla ba ta ya/ dmag dpon chen po shwa ta ya/ bhai snu rā bhe dzaḥ bhe ma ra tsa ya/ thang thang bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ thal ba dgra phyogs su gtor ro// las sbyor zhal gdams rdzogs so// dge'o/// / ༈ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam thos sras sgab 'dre mnan thabs la/ bse yi byang bu sor bzhi pa gcig byas la/ gnod sbyin shes pa dkar po rta skya bo la zhon pa'i gzugs gcig bris la/ bha a aṃ du ya ma rā dza ti ka rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥzhes bya bas g.yon phyogs su bskor/ snying gar dzaḥgacig bri/ shes pa dkar po u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ ces pas dzaḥde bskor/ de rta mgo skya bo'i nang du bcug /zha nye'am rin po che'i snod kyi nang du gser dngul ja rgun 'brum blugs/ bra bo la sogs 'bru nag bshos bu gru gang ba gcig kho la bsngo/ bal tshon dar khol gyis brgyan la bka' bsgo bya/ zhag gsum mal 'og tu bcug la/ ting nge 'dzin de/ bdag nyid phyag na rdo rjer bsgom/ phyag gi rdo rje 'phangs pas/ bse las grub pa'i mkhar bu gcig la phog pas rdul sub kyis bsgyel bar bsam/ nang nas dzaḥgacig 'od du gyur pa las// gnod sbyin shes pa dkar po ni// mi skya rta skya zhon pa gcig

/byung ba zhags pas bcings nas ni// phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga ru// mkhun pa thib thib 'don pas ni// da lta nyid du gtang gyur na// mtha' yi lcags ri'i phar rgyab tu/ kho ni 'gro bar nus so skad// phyag na rdo rje'i bsnyen pa la// zhag gsum bar la sbrel la btags// rmi lam rtags ni 'di ltar 'byung*// btson la bzung btags byas pa dang*// skyes pa chas ngan thal ba dang*// mi reng dung 'bud thal ba dang*// de ltar rmi lam byung nas ni// sgo them nas 'jal ba'i gom pa nyi shu rtsa gcig na mnan pa bya/ mtshams gcad bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o// shes pa dkar po'i mnan thabs rdzogs so// /// / ༈ yang rgyal po'i pho brang ngam/ rten khyad par can gyi drung ngam/ tshong dus sam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad par can gyi drung du phyin na/ rā dza de la mi chags pa'i thabs ni/ rang badz+ra pā ṇir bsgoms pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ mdun du rgyal po gsal bar bskyed la/ bdag gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rā dza la phog /rā dza las 'od 'phros pas bsod nams can gang yin pa'i gnas khang gter mdzod la phog pas mar me las mar me mched pa ltar gyur nas/ 'jig rten gang yin gyi bkrag dang gzi mdangs thams cad bsdus nas rā dza la thim par bsam/ rā dza 'od du zhu nas bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de ni srog 'phrog pa dang dbang du bsdu ba'o// rā dza gzhan la mi chags pa'i gdams ngag go// /

༈ badz+ra pā ṇi la na mo/ rkang pa can brjid che ba'am/ dge bshes mi chen la phyag 'tshal ba'am/ rta 'phras sam so kham btab pa rgol ba rmis na rgyal po ma chun pa'i rtags yin pas phyag na rdo rje'i zil gyis gnon par bya/ rang nyid yi dam bzlas bsgom bya/ mdun na bde byed ltar rā dza gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstims la dbang bskur spyi bor phyag rdor bskyed/ rgyal po'i thugs kar gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud gnyis dang ldan par bsam/ lte bar sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ rtsibs brgyad la bai brgyad dang*/ hūm̐ bcu drug gi bar la bltems par bsam/ mu khyud phyi nang gnyis la badz+ra pā ṇi'i sngags bsam/ kha dog sngon po yar gzengs par bsam/ rtsibs kyi sa bon kun kyang yar gzengs par bsam/ thugs kar 'khor lo 'khor bar bsam la bzlas pa bya/ spro bsdu gzhung ltar bya/ gtso 'khor kun gyi sngags sam gzungs gang rung bya/ rtags ni tshur la phyag 'tshal ba'am/ dngos grub ster ba rmis na gtor ma phul bshags pa bya/ thugs kar 'khor lo mi bskor 'phro bcad la bzhag /rgyal po zhud pa'am rgud pa rmis na/ bskang gsol cho ga bya/ zil gnon gyi man ngag go// / ༈ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen sgrub las gsum rtags byung nas/ dngos grub ma byung na h+ya grī was dbang du bsdu bar bya ste/ gzhung ltar rā dza dam tshig pa bskyed/

ye shes pa bstim/ spyi bor rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur/ rā dza'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dmar po mu khyud gnyis dang ldan pa/ lte bar bai dang hrīḥsteng sngags kyis bskor/ rtsibs brgyad dbus dang dgur// bai dang hrīḥyis bcer bar bya// sngags dang sa bon bzhengs pa'o// thugs kar tsakra bskor zhing bzlas pa bya/ gser dang dngul rin chen dngos grub ster ba'i rtags byung na 'phro bcad/ gtor ma 'bul la bshags pa bya/ dbang du bsdu ba'i man ngag*/// / ༈ gso ba ni/ bai ni khong chud rgud pa'i rnam pa rmis na/ rang gi mdun du chos skyong ltar bskyed/ 'khor lo mi bskor/ rang gi hūm̐ dang bai gnyis las 'od 'phros lha klu gnod sbyin gyi mdangs bsdus nas kho la thim pas mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ de ltar yang yang bya'o// bdun nam nyer gcig bar du gso bar bya'o// gso ba'i man ngag*/// / ༈ ya ma srog las kyi yig sna las/ wa thod gshin rje'i btson khang dmar nag 'bar ba'i dbus su/ dmigs bya lha dang bral ba mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ bkrag mdangs dang bral ba de dag gi snying gar lcags bsregs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i steng du/ bai las rnam thos sras dmar nag khrag gi mdog can gshin rje'i cha lugs can/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gsol ba/ phyag na mdung dar bsnams pa/ sku las gsod byed kyi shan pa dang nad dug mtshon gsum du 'phro ba shin tu 'jigs pa gcig bsgom/

de'i mdun du ya ma rā dza dmar nag /g.yas su myos byed 'bar ba dmar nag /rgyab tu me ru tse dmar nag /g.yon du ral pa tshar dgu dmar nag gtso bo dang mthun pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog can/ bse mdung dang dung khrab bsnams pa bsgoms la/ ngag tu

ār+ya dzaṃ bha la la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa nas/ yak+ṣa ba ra li la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po brgyad// ces pa nas/ 'dod yon longs spyod dngos grub stsol// ces pas mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang*/ gnod sbyin chen po/ klu chen brgyad dang bcas la bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/// / ༈ phyag na rdo rje la na mo/ rnam thos sras srog rtsa yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs yig chung la/ srog rtsa gta' ru gzung bar 'dod na/ bla rdo zhes pa ni rdzas sna la byed pa yin la/ bla rdo ni gser dngul/ zangs/ lcags/ bye ru/ mu tig /mu men/ dung*/ mchong*/ shel/ zha rdo/ yang mi chung ra nas blangs pa na/ gri khrag /mtshal/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang dang bcu drug de rnams bsres la brdung yag bya'o// de la bla rdo zur bzhi pa gcig byas la/ byang sems/ mtshal/ shel dmar po dang*/ sho pad du gsal la/ zur bzhi bai re re bri/ zhabs su nṛ gcig bri/ bai mig tu ma bri/ de dar dmar du dril la/ pho mo'i rtsa bar du bltems la/ dar dang sman rin po ches btums la/ de za 'og skud pas rgya gram du bcings la/ spyi sgrub tu gri snying du/ rtsa g.yas g.yon du mthing shog la sin+dhu ra rang byung gis ma dmar mo bzhi bris la bzhir bcug /grub nas phyungs la zangs dmar gwa 'ur bcug /sho rnam sras sku ru shes par bya/ de mchan du thogs nas lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs/

༈ gzhan dbang du bsdu bar 'dod na/ gnas lnga lngar sku dang sngags bskor/ phyi ltar dmar chen gzhung bsnyen la/ oṃ ma hā rā dza yak+ṣa sa ma ya phyi ltar ro// gsang ba la yang snying ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā sarba tsit+ta rat+na hrīṃ dzaḥ bai shra ma ṇā ya hrīṃ/ oṃ ma ma traka sid+dhi sa ma ya/ oṃ ma ma traka bā su dung dung*/ oṃ ma ma traka kha dhe yang yang*/ oṃ ma ma traka tsit+ta bā su dhā ri hrīṃ dzaḥhūm̐/ de ni ma mo mkha' 'gro'i sngags so// gcun sngags ni/ oṃ bai rā dza ma ma sid+dhi bā su rat+na hūm̐ dzaḥhrīṃ hrīṃ/ las sbyor sngags so// nri sarba

gnas lngar gtso 'khor lnga lnga rang gi snying nang du/ de la phar 'phros pas kho'i gnas lngar gzir bar bsgom mo/ kho'i gnas lngar tsakra rtsibs bzhi pa dmar po re re bsgom pa yin/ de'i dbus su rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po bsgom/ rtsibs logs bzhi la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying nang du rnam sras bsgoms pa'i snying nang du pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su bai'am pad 'dab bzhi la ma trag bzhi bsgom/ snying gar me las grub pa'i rtsibs bzhi pa bsgom mo// de nas bsnyen pa la tsakra mi bskor/ sgrub pa las sbyor la bskor/ lha rnams 'khor ba ma yin no// de nas rang gi snying nang du tsakra mi 'khor nas bsgrub bya'i snying gar tsakra sngags dang bcas pa bskor/ de ni myur mgyogs glog gi phreng ba'i gnad yin no// /// / ༈ bsgrub bya'i rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i 'gag tu rtsibs bzhi dmar por bsam pa'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar dza re gcig bsam la/ de'i dbus su bai dmar po gcig bsgom/ rtsibs bzhi la ni nyi ma'i gdan re re'i steng du ma dmar tseg tseg re bsam pa la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bsgom/ dbus kyi bai 'od du zhu ba las dbang gi rnam sras sku mdog dmar po seng ge dmar po la 'chib pa/ sku la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na zangs kyi zangs chung bsnams pa/ g.yon na thod pa'i par bu/ rin po che'i nor bu re yod par bsam/

de las 'od zer tshwa tshwa 'phros pas kho'i tsakra lnga dang rtsa bsgul nas kho'i bcud rnams bsdus nas mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la thim/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi 'od du zhu ba de dbus kyi rnam sras la thim par bsgom/ rnam sras snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su/ me'i rtsibs bzhi pa gnyis bsam/ de'i dbus su bai la ḍā kis bskor bar bsam/ rtsibs bzhir ma trag bzhi'i snying gar h+ya dang 'khor bar bsgom/ h+ya las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bcud rnams bsdus pa de dbus kyi rnam sras la thim par bsgom/ steng lha 'og klu dang 'gro ba pho mo'i bcud dang nor rdzas rnams bsdus la/ rang dang gnas khang la bstims la sngags la 'bad par bshad/ smra ba bcad la bzla 'o// de ni sgrub pa las la sbyar ba'i man ngag rnams so// /// / ༈ bla ma yi dam la na mo/ ma trag bzhi'i snying gar zangs kyi rtsibs bzhi pa re bsam/ dbus ma dmar po la ma trag gis bskor bar bsgom/ ma ni mkha' 'gro yin trag ni srog sngags yin pas/ ma trag ni dbang du sdud pa la dbang ba yin no// gnod sbyin ḍā ki klu mo ḍā ki lha mo ḍā ki dbang sdud gza' ḍā ki bzhi yin/ bsgrub bya'i snying du bskor la gcud/ snying nang gi rnam sras mthe bong tsam la thim par bsgom mo// 'di ni zhal gdams kun no/// / ༈ bla ma yi dam la na mo/ rnam sras kyi phyi nang gsang sgrub la lugs mang bar 'dug kyang*/

khyad par rnam thos sras dmar po'i srog len yig sna ni/ gzhan bca' gzhi dam rdzas la sogs gzhung na gsal/ 'dir ya ma gshin rje ltar srog 'phrog gi nang sgrub dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma trag bzhi'i srog sngags btags lugs dang*/ 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus gzhan dbang du bya ba dang*/ bla rdo srog gta' ru gzung ba dang*/ gzungs thag dang sbrel te las la sbyar ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi sham bu btags lugs dang*/ lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor gyi longs spyod char ltar du dbang du sdud pa'i gdams ngag ni/ dang po gzhung bsnyen byas tshar nas zas dang gang dbang du bsdu 'dod pa na/ rang nyid rnam sras gzhung ltar bsgoms la/ rang gi tsit+ta de kha dog dmar ba/ rin po che'i pad+ma lta bu'i gur de'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po chi li ba gcig gi steng du/ rnam sras dmar po tshon gang ba seng ge la 'chib pa gcig bsgoms la/ de'i snying ga'i dbus su bai dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba bsgom/ de'i rgyab tu zangs 'khor rtsibs bzhi pa'i steng du ma trag bzhi bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ sku mdog dmar mo sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na 'gugs byed kyi lcags kyu bsnams pa/ g.yon na thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ de re re'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar chi le ba sran 'bru glebs pa tsam re re'i steng du ma trag sbrel ma re bsam/

rang sngags kyis dmar sgo re 'khor bar bsam/ de nas rmi lam gzhung nas bshad pa ltar byung tshar nas/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags btags/ 'od zer phar 'phro ba'i dus su 'jig rten gyi khams dmar lam lam gsal ba'i nang du 'od zer skar mda' lta bu/

lus dmar lam lam dang tsha 'ub 'ub song nas/ kho'i nus mthu stobs bkrag gzi mdangs rnams 'od zer du 'dus nas 'od kyi thig le dmar po de lcags kyus tog gis blangs nas rang gi thugs ka'i bai dmar po la thim par bsam la sngags bzla 'o// oṃ ma hā rā dza yak+ṣa sa ma ya/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya sarba tsit+ta rat+na sid+dhi hrīṃ dzaḥ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya hrīṃ/ nṛ sarba 'gul 'gul/ yeng yeng*/ dung dung*/ sdus sdus/ dza dzaḥ oṃ ma ma trag sid+dhi sa ma ya/ ma ma trag bā su dung dung*/ ma ma trag kha dhe yang yang*/ ma ma trag tsit+ta bā su dhā ri hrīṃ dzaḥhūm̐/ bai rā dza ma ma sid+dhi bā su rat+na hūm̐ dzaḥhrīṃ/ zhes bsnyen sngags la rim bzhin btags la/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'gro ba pho mo dbang du 'dus so// sngags phreng tsheg bar bcu gsum yod/ sngags 'bru rdog po dgu bcu go lnga yod/ sngags ma dang bu 'phrad yin/ ma lhag ma chad 'phri mnan med pa'i man ngag yin no// bsnyen sgrub dus su thun bzhag kha la kho'i lus mkha' 'gro'i dza la bstim/ dza mkha' 'gro bzhi la/ mkha' 'gro bzhi rnam sras la bstim/ de gzi brjid dang bcas tshur byon nas rang gi snying gar bstim mo// rnam sras yang dag gsang ba thugs kyi nying khu*/ gdams pa 'di ni snying dmar po phyung ba dang 'dra'o// gsang la sgrub pa mdzod/ gsang sgrub dmar po snying la sbos// // /

༈ rnam sras dmar po go can gyi/ bla rdo pha bang long bu gcig la/ gser ram mtshal gyis bai re re bris/ zhabs su nṛ bris/ nṛ mig tsa la tsa mig bai bris/ tsa seng ge dmar po 'o// bai rnam sras su bsgom/ yod na gri snying dbus su rnam sras 'ong*/ rtsa sbubs g.yas gnod sbyin gyi sngags/ g.yon klu brgyad snying po bstsal/ yang na rang gi snying de rnam thos sras mthe bong tsam zhig bsgom/ rtsibs bzhir ma trag bzhi'i snying gar mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bsgom/ de rnams kyi rgyab tu tsakra dmar po 'khor bas dzam bu gling gi pho mo thams cad dang zas nor thams cad bkug pa de rang la bstim/ zhal gdams so// oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya/ sarba tsit+ta rat+na sid+dhi hrīṃ dzaḥ bai shra ma ṇā hrīṃ/ ha ri ni sa nṛ sarba 'gul 'gul/ yeng yeng*/ dung dung*/ sdus sdus/ dza dzaḥ myur mgyogs glog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di la khro bo ltar bsgrub pas sgab 'dre med/ zab*/ dge'o/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ rnam sras dmar po'i srog sgrub 'di gsang nas bsgrub par bya'o// dkyil 'khor gling bzhi ri rab bri/ steng du 'bru rigs dkar gsum mngar gsum sha chang zan thud bsres pa'i rten gtor bang rim bzhi pa la/ steng du lcog gcig la bang rim nor bus brgyan pa sor brgyad pa la bum pa brgyad shing brgyad bya/ gling bzhi lcags ri dang bcas pa bya'o// steng du 'bru rigs bcu ga la/

tshom bu lnga'am dgus bskor/ de'i steng du srog gi 'khor lo bzhag ste/ tsakra ni gser gyi sa gzhi byas la/ rin po che sna tshogs dri bzang gis bya/ tsakra'i lte bar srog gi bla rdo pha bang long bu la bai drug bris/ dar sna lngas rgya gram du bcings la/ tsakra dang lhan cig tu za 'og gis dril la bzhag /de yang tshon skud kyis bcings la 'bru rigs lnga sman lnga rnams dang zangs kyi gwa'ur bstsal ba steng du bzhag /mchod pa bshams la rang yi dam du bsgom/ mdun du rten gtor de rin po che sna lnga'i ri rab dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs pa/ de'i steng du rin po che sna lnga'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa phyi lcags ri yid bzhin gyi nor bus brgyan pa/ gter gyi bum pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad/ dpag bsam shing*/ gter brgyad/ khrus kyi rdzing bu brgyad kyis bskor bar bsam/ de'i dbus su 'dab bzhi 'dab brgyad dmar po pad+ma zla ba'i steng du bai dmar po lnga'am gcig bsgom/ 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas mchod cing sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba bsal nas/ nor lha thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pa de'i 'od zer bai la thim/ de nor bu bais mtshan pa lnga'am gcig tu gyur te/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ steng lha thams cad/ 'og klu thams cad/ bar mi thams cad kyi bcud/ srog gi dwangs ma thig le dkar la dmar zhing 'tsher ba lta bur bsdus nas nor bu la thim pa de yongs su gyur pa las/

rgyal po rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po khro zhing 'dzum pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ phyag g.yas nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon lcags kyu dang ne'u le'i kha nas rin po che skyugs pa gcig bsgom/ rin po che'i rgyan dang bse khrab dang ldan pa rgyal po'i cha byad can du bsgom/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon du nyi zlas brgyan pa/ de'i g.yon du yum lha mo pad+ma can dmar po/ g.yas nor bu/ g.yon bum pa/ sbrul gyi gdengs ka can gcig gis sku brten par bsgom/ phyogs bzhir phrin las bzhi'i rnam thos sras bzhi dang*/ yum bzhi yang shes par bya/ pad 'dab brgyad la gnod sbyin sras brgyad ni/ dzaṃ bha la/ gang ba bzang po/ nor bu bzang po/ ku be ra/ yang dag shes/ 'brog gnas/ lngas rtsen/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa lī/ 'di rnams kyang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas nor bu g.yon ne'u le rin po che'i rgyan dang bse khrab gyon par bsgom/ de'i rgyab tu nor lha thams cad dang gnod sbyin mang pos bskor nas bzhugs par bsgoms la/ spos dkar dud pa btang la spyan drang ba ni/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can// zhes pa nas/ sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes rgyal po 'khor bcas spyan drangs la bstim/ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes pas nor bu rin po che re res dbu brgyan par bsam/

mchod pa lngas mchod la/ sha chang dkar gsum mngar gsum ma 'dzom na/ gtor ma yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs byas la/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya/ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes pas dbul/ 'khor rnams la a kā ros phul la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas// zhes pa nas/ bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang bstod la/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar srog gi tsakra yi ge dang bcas pa dmar sgor ro ro g.yon du 'khor zhing*/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i sa bon dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas nor lha thams cad dang*/ lha klu mi nor thams cad kyang 'dar si li li dbang du 'dus par bsgoms la/ srog gi snying po 'bum tsho gcig bgrang*/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dza dzaḥ 'di'i skabs su yi dam la btags/ da ni dngos grub blang ba ni/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i srog gi tsakra dmar po de/ gser gyi tsakra ser po g.yas su sgor ro ro 'khor nas bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi sne mo la/ rang yi dam gyi sa bon gyi zhabs su bai bsgoms la/ rā dza'i srog sngags kyis bskor nas dbang du 'dus par bsam/ mchod pa sna tshogs spros pas rgyal po 'khor bcas mnyes shing*/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi srog gi tsakra yig 'bru dang bcas pa la/

srog gi nus mthu bcud len 'od zer ser po byung nas bdag la thim pas/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams gzi mdangs rgyas par bsam/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi zhal dang ne'u le'i kha nas rin po che sna tshogs kyi char babs nas bdag gi gnas khang gang bar bsam/ rā dza'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ steng lha'i 'byor pa 'og klu'i 'byor pa kun bskul nas bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam la/ dngos grub kyi sngags 'di gong ma la btags/ zas nor char ltar 'beb par bsam la/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya/ rat+na sid+dhi ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes dang sbrel/ gter rnyed pa dang nor tshong la phyin pa rmis pa'o// bsnyen rtags thon nas rā dza 'khor bcas la mchod pa 'bul/ gsol ba gdab/ 'od du zhu nas 'khor lo la bstims pa gter gyi phung po chen por bsgoms la gwa'u rang gi lus la bcangs pas grib ma ltar 'khor ba'o// 'di ni rnam sras yang gsang srog sgrub bo// gdams ngag dam pa 'di ni zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i yig chung mgul khug ma'o// 'dir yig sna rnam sras dmar po'i bla rdo pha bang long bu gcig la gser ram mtshal gyis bai re re bris/ zhabs su nṛ bris/ nṛ mig tu tsa bris/ tsa mig bai re re bris/ tsa seng ge dmar po/ bai rnam sras su bskyed/ yang gri snying nang du sngags bcug /rtsa sbubs g.yas su gnod sbyin sngags so// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje/

rgyal bu g.yu sgra snying po/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ zhang lha bzang skyid/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snub nyi she /dbus pa dmar ston/ 'od zer bla ma/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/ slob dpon thabs blo/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' grags/ bla ma bsod nams rin chen pa/ dpal ldan bla ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra/ des bdag la gnang ba'o// shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ dge'o// / oṃ ma hā rā dza yak+ṣa sa ma ya/ bai shra ma ṇā ya sarba tsit+ta rat+na sid+dhi hrīṃ hrīṃ dza dzaḥ bai shra ma ṇā ya hrīṃ hrīṃ/
